simple.meaning: פְּסַנְטֵרִין (pᵉçanṭêrîyn) is a Hebrew word meaning “psalterion ; a lyre.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פְּסַנְטֵרִין (H6460) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 3:5, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פְּסַנְטֵרִין (H6460) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פְּסַנְטֵרִין (H6460) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פְּסַנְטֵרִין (pᵉçanṭêrîyn) / H6460 is traced through Daniel 3:5, Daniel 3:7, Daniel 3:10, Daniel 3:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.

timeline.evidenceText: that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.

Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
You, O king, have made a decree, that every man that hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, shall fall down and worship the golden image;

Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god that will deliver you out of my hands?”

definitions.full: H6460. pesanterin מְּסַנְטֵרִין noun [masculine] a (triangular) stringed instrument (Greek ψαλτήριον , Krauss i. 12, 99, 101; ii. 473 Prince EB 3232 Dr Dn lviii, and on 3, 5 ); — ׳פ Dan 3:7 , מְּסַנְתֵּירִין 3:5 ; 3:10 ; 3:15 .
